compiled_state.title: ci-llm-review: DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE env var disagrees with ledger cycle_num -> incorrect cycle routing
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

On integration review passes where DSO_SUPPRESS_PRIOR_DEFENSES=true, the WARNING 'DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE=N disagrees with ledger cycle_num=1; ledger wins' appears consistently. The env var computed from PR comment history overshoots the ledger authoritative count. The ledger forces cycle_num=1 which may prevent cycle-dependent gates from firing correctly.

**Observed on**: PRs #364, #365, #368, #371
**Impact**: Cycle-dependent logic (novelty gate, two-call dispatch) may not fire at correct cycle number

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 4 (INTERMEDIATE). Severity=2(high), Complexity=1(moderate), Environment=1(CI), Intermittent=0(deterministic).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Investigation complete (INTERMEDIATE). Root cause: _init_cycle_ledger (runner.py:409-452) does not implement SHA-change cycle reset. cycle_number retains old count after new commits. cycle_dispatcher.next_action has correct SHA-reset but its return is not propagated back to cycle_number. Secondary: CI workflow DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE env var overcounts by tallying finding headers across all commits. Fix: add SHA-reset to _init_cycle_ledger (requires passing reviewed_sha and moving git rev-parse earlier in flow).
